acceptance_checks.when: commit is called with provenance.source="spectra-planning-session" and a valid author_agent
acceptance_checks.then: status==committed, stored provenance.source==verified_agent, author_agent preserved verbatim, no ValidationError
acceptance_checks.verify_method: pytest new test in test_server.py (make test-file)

acceptance_checks.given: any of {human, verified_agent, unverified_agent, environment} as source
acceptance_checks.then: stored source is byte-for-byte identical AND no provenance_coercion advisory attached

acceptance_checks.when: source is absent, empty, or descriptive
acceptance_checks.then: coerced source is never human (verified_agent for T1, unverified_agent for T2/T3); no spurious permanent protection
acceptance_checks.verify_method: pytest new guard test near test_protected.py

acceptance_checks.given: created_at as epoch int, Z-suffixed ISO, or non-ISO garbage
acceptance_checks.then: parses where possible (epoch/Z) or safely falls back to server-now (garbage); never crashes
result carries non-fatal provenance_coercion {field,from,to}; with no coercion, no advisory field present
no schemas/*.v1.json, no ECL envelope schema, no install.manifest.json modified; install.sh second-run-no-diff green
acceptance_checks.verify_method: git diff --stat schemas/ install.manifest.json empty; install idempotency CI
